nodes.question: What environmental challenges do Anxi cattle (AX) face in their habitat?
nodes.answer: Anxi cattle (AX) are adapted to the cold, arid environments and poor-quality forage of the Gobi Desert.

nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How does the Australian pastoral industry relate to data-driven sustainability?
nodes.answer: The Australian pastoral industry has become one of the most recent industries to adopt data-driven sustainability, relying on data from extensive monitoring and surveillance.
